svg.text: Project Circle · side-view blueprints of the two new regions · 1 grid step = 1 Unity unit · nothing built yet · each enemy appears only after the ability that answers it
NEW (dashed): Graveyard and Slums scenes, joined by doors
Blade + pogo only. Snapped-off corners piled high. Ends with the Runner's String (+ DASH), then a gap that needs it and the first Charger.
fall in: climb back out on the left
Dash is in play. In the square: where the villagers stood together (+ PARRY) and the Mirror. After it: enemies you parry. Then the Warden's Gate.
EDGE OF THE VILLAGE · CHASERS · CHARGER
LOWER STREETS · SENTRY · ORB CASTER · SWARM
T1 · Worn Tablet — “Here lie the corners they snapped off us. A triangle with a broken vertex is no triangle, they said.”
T2 · Scratched Tablet — “My corner chipped in a fall. By morning my own family would not look at me. We are still triangles.”
T3 · Inscription — “Only one who holds the shape of the first may pass.” (Shrine of the First Break, opened later with the Mould)
Runner's String (+ DASH) — one who outran the ones hunting them. Their string lets the circle slip past what charges at it.
Parry string — the villagers who stood together when the Warden's guards came. Standing together turns their power back.
T4 · Warden's Notice — “BY ORDER OF THE WARDEN: scalenes keep below the Line. Uneven sides, uneven rights.”
Slums Mirror (thoughts) — “They were thrown down too… and still they keep each other below.” / “The same whisper the old one heard.”
• Hall of Strings → blade + pogo. Graveyard has only what those beat:
chasers (no lasers), Spires to pogo, a Splitter.
• Runner's String at the end of the Graveyard → + DASH. Right after:
a gap you must dash across, then the first Wedge Charger.
• Slums edge: chasers and a Charger (dash). In the square: + PARRY,
then the Mirror. After that: Ceiling Sentry, orb caster, Swarm.
• Base Warden needs the parry (its bolt). Beating it frees the Slums
and gives + DOUBLE JUMP (built in a later step).
• Graveyard has no Mirror: dying returns you to the Old Triangle's.
